home.hero_subtitle: Tell us what's in your fridge and we'll find the perfect recipes. No more food waste — just delicious meals.
home.cuisine_section_subtitle: Pick a cuisine and we'll instantly search for matching recipes.
home.how_section_title: From fridge to table in 3 steps
home.how_step1_desc: Type what you have in your fridge or pantry — even partial lists work great.
home.how_step2_desc: Our AI scans thousands of recipes and ranks them by how many ingredients you already have.
home.how_step3_desc: Follow step-by-step instructions, watch video tutorials, and save your favourites.
home.features_section_subtitle: Built for real cooks, not just food bloggers.
home.feature_search_desc: Enter what you have and discover recipes sorted by how many ingredients you already own.
home.feature_save_desc: Bookmark recipes you love to your Watch Later list so they're always ready when you are.
home.feature_video_desc: Watch step-by-step cooking videos sourced from top YouTube chefs worldwide.
home.feature_ai_desc: Ask our built-in AI chef anything — substitutions, techniques, dietary tips, and more.
home.feature_nutrition_desc: Get detailed calorie, macro, and micronutrient breakdowns for every recipe.
home.feature_history_desc: Pick up where you left off. All your recent searches are saved and instantly accessible.
home.feature_dietary_desc: Filter by vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, keto and more — find recipes that match your lifestyle.
home.feature_quick_desc: Short on time? Filter by cook time and find delicious meals ready in under 30 minutes.
home.testimonials_section_subtitle: Join thousands of home cooks who've transformed their kitchens.
home.testimonial1_text: RecipeMate saved dinner last night! I had random veggies and it found me 3 amazing recipes. The video tutorials sealed the deal.
home.testimonial2_text: With two kids and a packed schedule, this app is a lifesaver. I type what's in the fridge and dinner is sorted in minutes.
home.testimonial3_text: The AI chat is incredible. I asked about substitutions for an obscure spice and got a detailed, helpful answer instantly.
home.cta_subtitle: Start for free — no account needed. Just type your ingredients and discover hundreds of delicious recipes instantly.
